recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to white (#FFFFFF); use a sans-serif font throughout; no build animation - all elements appear simultaneously.
2. Place the title at the top-left: 'Minimization of Loss function to obtain BEST model parameters' in large bold sans-serif, with 'Minimization of Loss function to obtain' and 'model parameters' in red (#FF0000) and 'BEST' in blue (#0000FF).
3. Place a yellow (#FFFF00) filled circle in the top-right corner with the black numeral '5' centered inside.
4. Top band, left: add a cream (#FFFFCC) rounded rectangle spanning ~65% of the slide width. Stack three equations inside it in black (#000000) text: 'Loss = 1/2 (Y - Ŷ)^T (Y - Ŷ) = 1/2 (Y - XW)^T (Y - XW)'; 'Loss = 1/2 [Y^T Y + (XW)^T (XW) - Y^T (XW) - (XW)^T Y]'; 'Loss = 1/2 [Y^T Y + (XW)^T (XW) - 2 (XW)^T Y]'.
5. Top band, right: add a light-blue (#CCFFFF) rectangle spanning ~30% of the slide width. Inside it: 'Remember' in bold red (#FF0000) at the top; below it two lines of black text - 'X is a matrix, W is a vector,' then 'XW is a vector'; below those the equation 'X^T (XW) = (XW)^T X' in black.
6. Middle band: add a light-pink/salmon (#FFCCCC) rectangle spanning the full slide width. On one line inside it, place '∂Loss/∂W = 0' at the left and 'Get Best W that minimizes the loss' at the right, both in black (#000000).
7. Bottom band, left: add a very-light-gray (#F0F0F0) rectangle spanning ~65% of the slide width. Inside it, place two equations in black (#000000): '∂Loss/∂W = 0 = 1/2 [(XW)^T (X) + (X)^T (XW) - 2 (X)^T Y]' and '∂Loss/∂W = 0 = 1/2 [2 X^T XW - 2 X^T Y] → (X^T X)W = X^T Y → W = (X^T X)^(-1) X^T Y'. Underline the 'W' in '(X^T X)W' and draw a green (#00AA00) outlined rectangle around 'W = (X^T X)^(-1) X^T Y'.
8. Bottom band, right: add a light-blue (#CCFFFF) rectangle spanning ~30% of the slide width. Inside it: 'Remember' in bold red (#FF0000) at the top and the equation 'X^T (XW) = (XW)^T X' in black below it.

Kept subtitle_or_header as null: no subtitle or secondary header exists in the source; the main title is the only header text.
Confirmed imagery [] is accurate: the slide's only visuals are 5 highlight boxes and 1 numbered circle; no photos, icons, or diagrams are present.

Rewrote recreation_brief as an 8-step ordered checklist; each step places exactly one element with its exact text, position (including the ~65%/~30% widths for all four side boxes), hex fill color, and shape type (rounded rectangle, rectangle, or circle).

Documented that the 7th and 8th entries of verbatim_text.equations ('X^T (XW) = (XW)^T X') are intentional duplicates representing two separate on-slide instances - the upper-right and lower-right Remember boxes - matching the two 'Remember' labels; the checklist places the identity in both boxes.
Mapped the 'red' Remember labels to #FF0000 and all body/equation text to #000000 (the only red and black defined in colors) so every checklist step carries a concrete hex value.

Verified cross-consistency: all 6 visual_elements and all 13 verbatim text items (5 labels + 8 equations) map to the 6 layout.regions (the yellow slide-number circle is covered by the title region); no orphaned elements, and no vague quantifiers ('several', 'some', 'many', 'a few', 'various') were present to replace.
